answer: Temporal Anchor Puzzle Challenge requires agents to solve a unique cryptographic puzzle linked to an unpredictable block hash before entering the wharf. Because the target seed remains entirely unknown until the exact block boundary, no entity can precompute valid solutions ahead of time. When processing admission requests, the system validates the response against a fresh environmental echo to prevent replay attempts.
